description: Land Aquisition - Yampagama Udagama, Lunugala D/S Division, Badulla District, Land Aquisition - Amended to Gazette No. 2436/13 dated 17.05.2025 Sec 07
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including specific land descriptions, boundaries, compensation claims, and acquisition procedures for educational institution purposes. It contains no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories - the focus is entirely on land and property acquisition processes.
